payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check if the first k characters are reverse of last k characters. If n<2k+1, NO; else if all s[i]==s[n-1-i] for i<k, YES, else NO.
payload.rationale: The solution uses two fixed indices (i and n-1-i) to compare characters, akin to a two-pointer palindrome check. It greedily verifies the necessary and sufficient condition for the string composition.
